The Court Exclusives — merged & refined

One design per court, mixed from both candidates at your word: the A you liked for substance, the B you liked for flair, and a heavier detail pass aimed at the quadruped weak spots — jointed legs, structured muzzles, muscle masses breaking the barrel line.

CINDERMAW — The Furnace Mastiff · Ember

The Mastiff’s heavy frame, ember cracks laid into the dark flanks and spine (now branching), the glowing maw and bronze medallion — merged with the Courser’s mane of living flame tongues running down the neck and spine. Legs rebuilt joint by joint; the muzzle is a stacked bridge, nose leather and jaw, not a box.

PALE STALKER — The Crystal Wolf · Frost

The Frost Wolf’s taller lupine frame and its neck ruff of layered ice-fur fins, shard ears and chest crystal — merged with the Panther’s spine of ice crystals, graded tall at the shoulders. Frost scoring seams the flanks; the legs bend the right way at stifle and hock; cheek fins give the head its wolf read.
